decisions.statement: The trait research catalog arrives as an argument and is handed straight on.
A character read only for roster fields is left out of the tallies.
The roster size counts an unmeasured row beside a measured row.
A storage pet the account has raises the bag size a pack upgrade is read from.
A pack upgrade count is held between zero and the most a bag admits.
A character of no measured level is given a maximum level of zero.

definition: one reading of a character roster, gathering the per-character tallies beside it
